author: (A. Adams, 1856)

note.en: A small three-winged murex (a typhis) recorded once at 3 m at Cahuita. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Cahuita, 1998). Size is typical for the genus, not measured from the record.
note.es: Un murex pequeño de tres alas (un tifis) registrado una vez a 3 m en Cahuita. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Cahuita, 1998). El tamaño es típico del género, no medido en el registro.

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Cahuita, 1998)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Cahuita, 1998).

marks.en: Small shell with three frilly, winged ridges running down it, giving a triangular outline.
marks.es: Concha pequena con tres crestas onduladas en forma de ala que le dan un contorno triangular.
